title: Second-open substitution and its proper/open projection square
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p_0,\ell$, integers $d,n\geq1$, $\kappa=\overline{\mathbf F_{p_0^d}}$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Work with a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] and the specified canonical exchange and projection maps [def-exchange-projection, def-sf-pf]. All schemes are separated finite-type $\kappa$-schemes and all morphisms are separated of finite type. Write $P_h=Lh^*$, $S_h=Rh_!$ and $J_i=i_!$ for an open immersion; for proper $h$ use $S_h=Rh_*$. All tensors are derived over $\Lambda$, and $\sigma$ is the signed symmetry. Use the canonical composition comparisons $\alpha_{h,e}:S_hS_e\cong S_{he}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition], on the bounded constructible etale-origin domain identified by [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. For $A$ on the target of $h$ and $N$ on its source, put $\Theta_h(A,N)=S_h(\sigma)\operatorname{PF}_{h,N,A}\sigma:A\otimes S_hN\to S_h(P_hA\otimes N)$. For $h:V\to B$, $z:Z\to B$, projections $r_0:V\times_BZ\to V$, $s_0:V\times_BZ\to Z$, and $C\in D^b_{ctf}(V,\Lambda)$, $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,\Lambda)$, define the specified map
$$\lambda_{h,z}(C,N)=\alpha_{z,s_0}\,S_z\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{s_0,P_{r_0}C,N}(\operatorname{Ex}_{h,z}(C)\otimes1)\bigr)\Theta_z(S_hC,N).$$
Juxtaposition composes right to left, with the canonical pullback and tensor associators inserted. Let $a:\bar X\to B$ and $b:\bar Y\to B$ be proper and $k:Y\hookrightarrow\bar Y$ open (the letter $k$ denotes this open immersion; the base field is $\kappa$). Put $U=\bar X\times_BY$, $W=\bar X\times_B\bar Y$, with projections $r:U\to\bar X$, $s:U\to Y$, $P:W\to\bar X$, $Q:W\to\bar Y$, and $w=1_{\bar X}\times_Bk:U\hookrightarrow W$. For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(\bar X,\Lambda)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$, put $H=P_PM$ and $N=P_wH\otimes P_sL$. Let $\beta:P_QJ_kL\xrightarrow{\sim}J_wP_sL$ be normalized open base change and let $\widetilde\gamma_{w,H,A}:H\otimes J_wA\xrightarrow{\sim}J_w(P_wH\otimes A)$ be the signed open tensor map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Set
$$e_2=\widetilde\gamma_{w,H,P_sL}(1\otimes\beta):H\otimes P_QJ_kL\xrightarrow{\sim}J_wN.$$
Thus $e_2$ is the one-open external tensor comparison of [lem-sf-open-external-tensor-normalization]. For $C$ on $W$, put $E_C=\operatorname{Ex}_{Q,k}(C):P_kS_QC\to S_sP_wC$. For $C$ on $U$, let $\Gamma_C:J_kS_sC\to S_QJ_wC$ be the $J_k\dashv P_k$-adjunct of $(E_{J_wC})^{-1}:S_sC\to P_kS_QJ_wC$, using $P_wJ_wC\cong C$ and the identity normalization of the open unit. Then
$$\Gamma_C=\alpha_{Q,w,C}^{-1}\alpha_{k,s,C},$$
and the following square of specified morphisms commutes:
$$S_Q(e_2)\operatorname{PF}_{Q,H,J_kL}
=\Gamma_N\,J_k\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{s,P_wH,L}(E_H\otimes1)\bigr)\Theta_k(S_QH,L).$$
Consequently the following equality of the specified exchange/projection composites holds, with targets identified by $S_bJ_kS_s\cong S_bS_QJ_w$:
$$\lambda_{a,bk}(M,L)=S_bS_Q(e_2)\lambda_{a,b}(M,J_kL).$$

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, expanded compactification reduction; Returned proof steps 1, 2, 5, 6, 7: signed projection composition, horizontal exchange pasting, normalized proper/open square and second open-factor substitution. Agent-formulated identity; the proof-coherence paragraph supplies the canonical projection and exchange route.

proof.text: The square $(s,w,Q,k)$ is Cartesian. Its verticals $Q,s$ are proper, being base changes of $a$, by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence]; its opens are quasi-compact since they are finite type. The canonical exchange $E:P_kS_Q\cong S_sP_w$ agrees with the open-restriction comparison in [lem-sf-cartesian-open-adjunction-restriction]: that lemma's counit equation is precisely its mate formula in [def-exchange-projection]. The normalized proper/open comparison of [lem-sf-proper-open-tensor-compatibility], specialized to this Cartesian square, is consequently the $J_k\dashv P_k$-adjunct of $E_{J_wC}^{-1}$; the auxiliary clopen map there is the identity. Hence it is exactly $\Gamma_C$, and $E_{J_wC}P_k\Gamma_C=1$ after the open unit identification. Now use the compositor normalization stated in [lem-sf-composition-projection-mate]. For $f=s$, $g=k$ choose the compactification $(k,1_{\bar Y})$ of $k$ and the compatible triangle $(j,b,q,p)=(1_U,w,s,Q)$. The normalized tower comparison is precisely $\Gamma$. For $f=w$, $g=Q$ choose $(1_W,Q)$ and $(w,1_W,1_W,1_W)$ for the analogous triangle; its proper/open comparison is the identity, giving the chosen compactification $(w,Q)$ of $Qw=ks$. Thus $\alpha_{Q,w}\Gamma=\alpha_{k,s}$ in these compactification coordinates. The natural, compactification-independent compositors of [thm-sf-comp-composition] give $\Gamma_C=\alpha_{Q,w,C}^{-1}\alpha_{k,s,C}$ as asserted. Their domain includes the inputs here by [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin].

proof.text: Put $D=H\otimes P_QJ_kL$ and $T=\operatorname{PF}_{s,P_wH,L}(E_H\otimes1)$. By [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], $P_we_2$ is the identity of $N$ after $P_wH\otimes P_sP_kJ_kL=N$ is identified using the open unit. Indeed restriction of $\beta$ and of the open tensor map are identities, and the signed variant inserts two mutually inverse symmetries. This also identifies $e_2$ with the one-open external tensor map in [lem-sf-open-external-tensor-normalization]. For any $A$ on $\bar Y$, the signed open projection $\Theta_k(A,L)$ restricts to the identity of $P_kA\otimes L$: the restriction of the open projection is the identity and its two signed symmetries cancel. These assertions use the actual normalized maps, not just existence of an isomorphism.

proof.text:
Compare the proposed square under the bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}(S_QH\otimes J_kL,S_QJ_wN)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(P_kS_QH\otimes L,P_kS_QJ_wN).$$
The inverse open projection identifies its source with $J_k(P_kS_QH\otimes L)$; use its identity restriction from step 2. Postcompose the adjoints with the invertible $E_{J_wN}$. Naturality of $E$ at $e_2$ makes the left-hand adjunct
$$S_s(P_we_2)\,E_D\,P_k(\operatorname{PF}_{Q,H,J_kL}).$$
The base-change square for the projection transformation in [prop-sf-pf-coherence], applied to $(s,w,Q,k)$ and the pair $(H,J_kL)$, identifies this with
$$S_s(P_we_2)\,\operatorname{PF}_{s,P_wH,P_kJ_kL}(E_H\otimes1)=T.$$
The last equality is step 2 and naturality in the second input. The right-hand adjunct is $T$, since $E_{J_wN}P_k\Gamma_N=1$ by step 1, $P_kJ_kT=T$ by naturality of the open unit, and $P_k\Theta_k(S_QH,L)=1$ by step 2. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection proves
$$S_Q(e_2)\operatorname{PF}_{Q,H,J_kL}=\Gamma_NJ_k(T)\Theta_k(S_QH,L).$$
Here $Q,s$ are proper base changes of $a$, so the proper direct-image and shriek projection maps coincide by the proper clause of [prop-sf-pf-coherence].

proof.text:
Write $A=S_aM$, $F=P_bA$, and $v=\operatorname{Ex}_{a,b}(M):F\to S_QH$. Horizontal exchange pasting in [fix-lem-exchanges], for the base changes $b$ followed by $k$, gives
$$\operatorname{Ex}_{a,bk}(M)=E_H\,P_kv.$$
All pullback compositors here identify $P_wH=P_rM$. The composition pentagon for the projection maps in [prop-sf-pf-coherence], applied to $k$ followed by $b$, gives its signed version
$$\Theta_{bk}(A,L)=S_b(\Theta_k(F,L))\,\Theta_b(A,J_kL),$$
through $S_{bk}=S_bJ_k$. To obtain this formula expand each $\Theta$ as $S(\sigma)\operatorname{PF}\sigma$; naturality of the signed symmetry moves it through the compositor and through the second projection map, and each adjacent pair $\sigma_{V,U}\sigma_{U,V}$ is the identity. Thus this is exactly the projection composition identity on the reversed tensor factors, with the same Koszul signs. Naturality of $\Theta_k$ in its first input also gives
$$J_k(P_kv\otimes1)\Theta_k(F,L)=\Theta_k(S_QH,L)(v\otimes1).$$

proof.text:
Expand $\lambda_{a,bk}$ using step 4. With the target initially written as $S_bJ_kS_sN$, the part inside $S_b$ after $\Theta_b(A,J_kL)$ is
$$J_k(T)\,J_k(P_kv\otimes1)\,\Theta_k(F,L)
=J_k(T)\Theta_k(S_QH,L)(v\otimes1).$$
Change this target to $S_bS_QJ_wN$ using $S_b\Gamma_N$. Step 3 replaces the last expression by
$$S_Q(e_2)\operatorname{PF}_{Q,H,J_kL}(v\otimes1).$$
Consequently, after restoring the outer composition comparison, the result is
$$S_bS_Q(e_2)\,\alpha_{b,Q}\,S_b\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{Q,H,J_kL}(v\otimes1)\bigr)\Theta_b(A,J_kL)
=S_bS_Q(e_2)\lambda_{a,b}(M,J_kL).$$
In this formula $S_bS_Q(e_2)$ denotes its conjugate by the outer compositor when the target is written as a single shriek functor. The insertion of $S_b\Gamma_N$ is precisely the target identification required in the statement: substitute step 1 and use associativity of $\alpha$ in [thm-sf-comp-composition] and $bks=bQw$. Naturality of that compositor moves $S_bS_Q(e_2)$ past it. This proves the final equality of specified composites.

Statement types check: Q and s are base changes of the proper map a, and the square (s,w,Q,k) is Cartesian because W×_Ȳ Y = U. The source of λ_{a,bk}(M,L) is S_aM⊗S_bJ_kL, and its target is S_{bks}N, the same as S_{bQw}N. The target identification S_bΓ reduces to plain compositors by associativity of α. Small cases: k = id gives a trivial identity; Y empty, L = 0 and M = 0 give zero maps. Step 1: the E of cartesian-open-adjunction-restriction (p=Q, i=k, b=w, q=s) has the same counit transpose as the Ex_* mate of def-exchange-projection. The Γ of proper-open-tensor-compatibility (k₁=w, r=s, p=Q, i=k, auxiliary s = id) is exactly the item's Γ_C. In composition-projection-mate the triangle (1_U,w,s,Q) for (k,s) gives α_{k,s} = Γ, and the triangle (w,1,1,1) for (Q,w) gives α_{Q,w} = 1; both compactify the composite as (w,Q). This matches the Stacks 0F7J construction through 0F7B (more-etale.tex l.3159 and l.2460). Step 2 (elementary): P_wβ, P_wγ and P_kΘ_k are identities by open-tensor-normalization, and the signed symmetries cancel. Step 3: I redid the J_k⊣P_k adjunct computation after postcomposing with E_{J_wN}. The left side reduces to T by naturality of E, the base-change clause of prop-sf-pf-coherence for (s,w,Q,k) and naturality in the second input. The right side reduces to T by the adjunct definition of Γ and step 2. No faithfulness is used. Step 4: horizontal pasting in fix-lem-exchanges (2) gives Ex_{bk} = E_H·P_kv; the signed pentagon follows from the projection-formula composition identity, with the σ pair cancelling. Step 5 (elementary substitution): I recomputed it; it uses Ex_{a,b} = v. Hypotheses checked: finite Λ, étale-origin domain via constructible-origin (ii), bk never assumed proper. Duplicate search (rg -L for open-substitution, second open, J_kS_s, Gamma_C): only the first-open sibling and unrelated supported-coefficient and exchange nodes.
